fan_the_flames.description: Push the target 2 tiles at Range 3 for 2 damage. Leave Fire on each tile the target passes through.

fault_strike.name: Fault Strike
fault_strike.description: Strike for 11, then leave Rubble on the target's tile and the 2 tiles behind the target.

flashsteam.name: Flashsteam
flashsteam.description: Deal 3 damage in the area at Range 3. Each Ice tile hit: also Burst 4 that Ice.

frost_circuit.name: Frost Circuit
frost_circuit.description: Leave Electrified on the tile within Range 3, then deal 2 damage and Shock the enemy on the tile. On Ice: also on each connected Ice tile.

frost_heave.name: Frost Heave
frost_heave.description: Deal 3 at Range 3 and Immobilize. If the target stands on Ice, also Burst 6 that Ice.

frozen_bite.name: Frozen Bite
frozen_bite.description: Strike for 5. On Ice: also Stagger 6, gain 1 Card Play and Draw 1.

gale_ward.name: Gale Ward
gale_ward.description: Gain 5 Block, then Push each adjacent enemy 1 tile away.

glide.name: Glide
glide.description: Move 3, leaving Ice on the tile you started on, then Draw 1.

grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.description: Blink to a tile adjacent to an enemy, Outcrop, Powder Keg or crate within Range 4.

grounding.name: Grounding
grounding.description: Gain 3 Stoneskin. Remove each Electrified tile within 2 tiles: +3 Stoneskin per tile, up to 9 total.

hall_of_mirrors.name: Hall of Mirrors
hall_of_mirrors.description: Create an Illusion with 2 Health on each empty adjacent tile, then gain 3 Block.

headsmans_toll.name: Headsman's Toll
headsmans_toll.description: Deal 3 at Range 3. If the target dies from this attack, gain 1 more Card Play and Draw 1.

hoarfrost_ward.name: Hoarfrost Ward
hoarfrost_ward.description: Gain 5 Block. Leave Ice on the tile of each enemy adjacent to you.

hotfoot.name: Hotfoot
hotfoot.description: Gain 2 Block, then Move 2. On Fire before the Move: +4 Block.

ice_sculpture.name: Ice Sculpture
ice_sculpture.description: Create an Illusion with 4 Health within Range 3, then leave Ice.

immolation.name: Immolation
immolation.description: Strike each adjacent tile for 3. Burst 8 each Fire tile within 1 tile of your tile, sparing you. Empower for 2 Health: each Fire tile within 2 tiles instead.

joust.name: Joust
joust.description: Move 4, then Strike for 7 and Push the target 2 tiles.

magma_vent.name: Magma Vent
magma_vent.description: Deal 4 to a tile within Range 3. On Rubble: also Burst 7 that Rubble, leaving Fire.

meteorfall.name: Meteorfall
meteorfall.description: Mark 3 tiles. At the start of your next turn, deal 8 damage on each Marked tile, then leave Fire.

plasma_arc.name: Plasma Arc
plasma_arc.description: Deal 3 damage with Chain 2 at Range 3. Each Fire tile hit: also Burst 4 that Fire.

powder_keg.name: Powder Keg
powder_keg.description: Consume. Place a keg with 3 Health within Range 2. When the keg is destroyed, the keg Bursts 6.

pyroclasm.name: Pyroclasm
pyroclasm.description: Deal 9 at Range 3. If the target stands on Fire, also Burst 6 that Fire.

refraction.name: Refraction
refraction.description: Deal 4 at Range 3. This attack also hits each enemy adjacent to one of your Illusions.

revealing_glare.name: Revealing Glare
revealing_glare.description: Expose 3 each enemy in Light within Range 4. Draw 1.

rime_step.name: Rime Step
rime_step.description: Move 3. Leave Ice on the tile of each enemy adjacent to you.

rockburst.name: Rockburst
rockburst.description: Deal 4 damage at Range 3. On an Outcrop or crate: also Burst 4 that terrain, leaving Rubble on each tile hit.

rooted_stance.name: Rooted Stance
rooted_stance.description: Gain 6 Stoneskin. You can't Move, Blink or Swap for the rest of this turn.

searing_light.name: Searing Light
searing_light.description: Deal 5 to each enemy standing in Light.

seek_the_light.name: Seek the Light
seek_the_light.description: Blink 2, or to any tile in Light within Range 5.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.description: Deal 5 damage at Range 3. If the target stands on Ice, also Burst 5 that Ice.

shatter_swing.name: Shatter Swing
shatter_swing.description: Strike for 10. If the target stands on Ice, also Burst 6 that Ice, sparing you.

shattered_reflection.name: Shattered Reflection
shattered_reflection.description: Create Light 2 on a tile within Range 6. On one of your Illusions: also Burst 6 that Illusion before the Light.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.description: Gain 12 Block. You can't Move, Blink or Swap for the rest of this turn.

shrug_off.name: Shrug Off
shrug_off.description: Gain 3 Block, then turn your Block into Stoneskin. Draw 1.

skate.name: Skate
skate.description: Move 3 and Draw 1. This turn, Ice costs you no Movement and doesn't Expose you.

skybolt.name: Skybolt
skybolt.description: Exhaust. Deal 8 damage to a visible enemy, ignoring Range and line of sight. This attack conducts through Electrified tiles and Shocks each unit hit.

sleet_squall.name: Sleet Squall
sleet_squall.description: Push the target 2 tiles away from you at Range 3, then deal 3 to the target. On Ice: also Stagger 6.

smelling_salts.name: Smelling Salts
smelling_salts.description: Consume. Remove Immobilize and Shock from yourself. Move 2.

static_ward.name: Static Ward
static_ward.description: Gain 5 Block, then leave Electrified on your tile and each adjacent enemy's tile.

stoke.name: Stoke
stoke.description: Deal 2 to each enemy you can see. On Fire: +3 damage.

stone_ward.name: Stone Ward
stone_ward.description: Gain 5 Block, then leave Rubble on each adjacent enemy's tile.

sunpath_stride.name: Sunpath Stride
sunpath_stride.description: Move 4, leaving Light 1 on each tile you enter.

thunderstone.name: Thunderstone
thunderstone.description: Consume. Deal 5 damage to a visible enemy, ignoring line of sight. Stagger 2.

vortex.name: Vortex
vortex.description: Choose a tile within Range 3. Pull each enemy within 2 tiles of that tile 2 tiles toward that tile.

windbreak.name: Windbreak
windbreak.description: Gain 6 Block. You can't be moved by Push or Pull until your next turn.

worldbreak.name: Worldbreak
worldbreak.description: Burst 10 an adjacent Outcrop you raised, sparing you. Stagger 2 each enemy hit.

worldspine.name: Worldspine
worldspine.description: Exhaust. Raise an Outcrop with 4 Health on each empty tile adjacent to the tile within Range 3. Rite. At the start of your turn, deal 3 damage to each enemy adjacent to an Outcrop you raised.
